title: Doctoral Position in Machine Learning for Engineering Design
institution: ETH Zurich, Laboratory for Intelligence in Design Engineering and Learning (IDEAL)
about: One to two doctoral positions in machine learning for engineering design at ETH Zurich's IDEAL lab, Department of Mechanical and Process Engineering, under Prof. Mark Fuge. Topics include self-supervised and transfer learning, industrial robotics and multi-agent coordination for design.

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I
why: Title "Doctoral Position in Machine Learning for Engineering Design" / field "Machine learning for engineering design" → objective "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods"
Field "Machine learning for engineering design" → objective "Semi-supervised and self-supervised learning: leveraging unlabelled data at scale"
